QuestInfo.name: [NLC] Glimmer Man: Private Investigator
QuestInfo.0: You met the Glimmer Man through the introduction of Professor Foxwit. He doesn't seem to be the trustworthy type, but he says he can send you into the alien base right through front doors. See if it's really true.
QuestInfo.1: You met the Glimmer Man through the introduction of Professor Foxwit. He doesn't seem to be the trustworthy type, but he says he can send you into the alien base right through front doors. See if it's really true.
QuestInfo.2: Glimmer Man teleported you to the alien base in the blink of an eye. The aliens turned out to be Cerberusians, leading you to wonder what brought them here.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: Talk to #p9201083# in #m600000000# and attack the alien base.
